msgs.t: Before we onboard you, send us your company profile.
PDF is fine. By Monday please 🙏

slides.h: Who you are, in one paragraph.
slides.b: Name, what you do, since when, where you work. Skip the mission statement.
One line each on what the client actually gets.
Client, what you did, when. Photos if you have them, with their permission.
Registration, KRA PIN, any licences. List them so procurement can tick the boxes.

slides.h: Contacts and how to pay you.
slides.b: One phone, one email, your till or bank details. On the last page.

slides.h:
A company profile
in Word or PDF. KES 5.
slides.b:
Tell Toso what your business does. Get the finished profile.
Pay with M-Pesa. No card, no monthly bill.
